title: Section 129
content: (1) Every vessel, company or port facility shall comply with such safety and security management requirements as may be prescribed. (2) The Central Government or a person authorised by it shall arrange for the audit of the vessel, company or port facility for the purpose of sub-section (1). (3) The Central Government or a person authorised by it may set different levels of security and provide such information thereof, to all the port facilities and all vessels entering into any port facility.
